# Upstream Typst PNG Parity Fixtures

This directory contains the PNG-only upstream Typst parity corpus for
`avenger-typst-label`. It compares Avenger's rasterized single-line label output
against small PNG references generated by upstream Typst from equivalent label
snippets.

This is a label-level raster oracle. It is not a full Typst document/page
render test suite.

## Scope

- Build PNG parity only.
- Keep the suite inside `avenger-typst-label` and behind the existing `raster`
  feature.
- Do not add SVG parity, PDF parity, chart baselines, scenegraph tests, browser
  tests, renderer integration, or PDF/text embedding validation here.
- Use upstream Typst only from the reference generator. The Rust parity test
  must be offline and compare Avenger output only against checked-in
  `ref/*.png` files.
- Keep snippets label-sized and single-line where possible. Do not copy Typst's
  full page-level render refs into this tree.

## Files

```text
avenger-typst-label/src/bin/generate_upstream_png_refs.rs
avenger-typst-label/tests/upstream_png_parity.rs
avenger-typst-label/tests/fixtures/upstream_png/README.md
avenger-typst-label/tests/fixtures/upstream_png/cases.toml
avenger-typst-label/tests/fixtures/upstream_png/src/{id}.typ
avenger-typst-label/tests/fixtures/upstream_png/ref/{id}.png
```

- `cases.toml`: one manifest entry per case.
- `src/{id}.typ`: label snippet only, without page setup.
- `ref/{id}.png`: curated upstream Typst PNG reference.

Each `cases.toml` entry records upstream provenance with `upstream_file` and
`upstream_test` so maintainers can trace the case back to
`../typst/tests/suite/...`.

## Required Commands

Run from the repository root, always in release mode:

```sh
cargo run --release -p avenger-typst-label --features upstream-png-parity --bin generate_upstream_png_refs
cargo test --release -p avenger-typst-label --features raster,upstream-png-parity upstream_png_parity -- --nocapture
cargo test --release -p avenger-typst-label --features raster -- --nocapture
```

The generator expects an upstream Typst checkout at `../typst`. It creates
temporary wrapped Typst documents under `target/typst-parity/src`, decompresses
Avenger's bundled Lato and Lete Sans Math fonts into
`target/typst-parity/fonts`, and calls Typst with explicit font paths plus
`--ignore-system-fonts`.

The test harness does not call upstream Typst. If a comparison fails, it writes
`expected.png`, `actual.png`, and `diff.png` under
`target/tests/upstream_png_parity/{case_id}/`.

## Build From Zero

Use this flow only when the suite is missing or is being deliberately rebuilt:

1. Create `tests/fixtures/upstream_png/{src,ref}` and a manifest-driven
   `cases.toml`.
2. Start with exactly two or three smoke cases:
   - one text decoration case;
   - one math fraction/root case;
   - one symbol case.
3. Add emoji only after deterministic system emoji font setup is proven.
4. Implement `src/bin/generate_upstream_png_refs.rs`.
   - Read and sort `cases.toml` by `id`.
   - Wrap each label snippet in a tiny auto-sized Typst page with white fill and
     a small inset.
   - Decompress Avenger's bundled Lato and Lete Sans Math fonts into
     `target/typst-parity/fonts`.
   - Call upstream Typst from `../typst` with explicit `--font-path`,
     `--ignore-system-fonts`, and `--ppi 72`.
   - Fail clearly if the upstream Typst checkout is missing.
5. Implement `tests/upstream_png_parity.rs`.
   - Read the same manifest; do not hard-code case IDs.
   - Compile through `LabelEngine`.
   - Rasterize through Avenger's raster API.
   - Composite transparent output over white.
   - Crop expected and actual to content plus padding.
   - Compare dimensions plus configured similarity/tolerance.
   - On failure, write `expected.png`, `actual.png`, and `diff.png` under
     `target/tests/upstream_png_parity/{case_id}/`.
6. Run the required commands.
7. Prove the harness by perturbing one checked-in reference PNG, confirming the
   failure output is useful, restoring/regenerating the ref, and rerunning the
   suite.
8. Commit only the PNG-suite files.

## Extend Existing Suite

Use this flow when adding coverage for implemented label behavior:

1. Run `git status --short` and identify unrelated dirty files before editing.
2. Read this README and `cases.toml`.
3. Pick one already-implemented feature family.
4. Read the relevant upstream Typst test file from `../typst/tests/suite`.
5. Reduce the upstream behavior to a label-sized snippet:
   - preserve the upstream spelling of the feature under test;
   - remove page setup, show rules, loops, tables, columns, counters, imports,
     and other document-level scaffolding;
   - keep only syntax that belongs to the supported single-line label subset.
6. If the upstream case requires unsupported scripting or document layout, add
   an unsupported-syntax unit test instead of a PNG parity fixture.
7. Add or update `src/{id}.typ`.
8. Add or update one `[[case]]` entry with upstream attribution.
9. Run the reference generator.
10. Inspect every changed `ref/*.png` directly or in a temporary mosaic.
11. Run the parity test.
12. If label-engine code changed, run the full crate raster suite.
13. Review `git diff` and stage only intentional suite files and curated refs.

## Acceptance Criteria

Every accepted reference PNG must be:

- non-blank;
- unclipped;
- label-sized;
- rendered with the intended Lato and Lete Sans Math fonts;
- visibly exercising the intended feature;
- traceable to an upstream Typst test through `cases.toml`.

For generator or comparator changes, temporarily perturb one checked-in
reference PNG, run the parity test, confirm the failure message includes the
case id and artifact paths, then restore/regenerate the reference before
committing.

## Choosing Cases

Good PNG parity cases:

- fit naturally on one label line;
- have deterministic visual output with the bundled fonts;
- exercise one retained feature family clearly;
- avoid Typst scripting, `#set`, `#show`, imports, counters, layout containers,
  matrix/table layout, and full-page behavior;
- can be attributed to one upstream file and test name in `cases.toml`.

Bad PNG parity cases:

- depend on page layout, block layout, columns, tables, counters, loops, or full
  Typst evaluation;
- require unsupported functions that should currently error;
- are mostly redundant with an existing visual fixture;
- hide the feature under a large expression where a one-line reduced case is
  clearer;
- need SVG/PDF output to be meaningful.

## Upstream Seed Map

Use this map when growing the corpus. Add one implemented feature family per
commit.

| Priority | Feature family | Upstream files to read | PNG-case guidance |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Text decorations | `../typst/tests/suite/text/deco.typ` | Underline, strike, overline, stroke/offset options. Use short words with descenders so line position is visible. |
| 1 | Case and scripts | `../typst/tests/suite/text/case.typ`, `../typst/tests/suite/text/shift.typ`, `../typst/tests/suite/text/smallcaps.typ` | Cover `#upper`, `#lower`, `#sub`, `#super`, `#smallcaps`; avoid paragraph cases. |
| 1 | Model emphasis | `../typst/tests/suite/model/emph-strong.typ`, `../typst/tests/suite/text/raw.typ` | Cover `_emph_`, `*strong*`, `#emph`, `#strong`, and raw backticks. |
| 1 | Symbols | `../typst/tests/suite/symbols/symbol.typ`, `../typst/tests/suite/math/symbols.typ` | Use named symbols that fit in one label. Keep emoji in its own case with `requires_system_emoji = true`. |
| 2 | Fractions and roots | `../typst/tests/suite/math/frac.typ`, `../typst/tests/suite/math/root.typ` | Prefer compact expressions that expose bar placement, styles, and root extenders. |
| 2 | Attachments and primes | `../typst/tests/suite/math/attach.typ`, `../typst/tests/suite/math/primes.typ` | Cover script vs limits placement, corner slots, and grouped prime syntax. |
| 2 | Accents and delimiters | `../typst/tests/suite/math/accent.typ`, `../typst/tests/suite/math/delimited.typ`, `../typst/tests/suite/math/stretch.typ` | Cover accent calls, `lr`, helper delimiter calls, `mid`, and stretch size. |
| 2 | Math classes/operators | `../typst/tests/suite/math/class.typ`, `../typst/tests/suite/math/op.typ`, `../typst/tests/suite/math/spacing.typ` | Use short expressions where spacing/class changes are visually obvious. |
| 2 | Cancel and under/over | `../typst/tests/suite/math/cancel.typ`, `../typst/tests/suite/math/underover.typ` | Include literal stroke/color/angle options and simple under/over lines. |
| 3 | Math styles/sizes/text | `../typst/tests/suite/math/style.typ`, `../typst/tests/suite/math/size.typ`, `../typst/tests/suite/math/text.typ` | Add after the corresponding retained label functionality has unit coverage. |

Skip these upstream suites unless Avenger later implements the needed label
subset:

- `../typst/tests/suite/math/cases.typ`, `mat.typ`, `vec.typ`,
  `multiline.typ`, and `alignment.typ`, because they depend on matrix/table or
  multiline layout.
- `../typst/tests/suite/model/*` other than `emph-strong.typ`, because most
  model tests exercise document/page semantics.
- `../typst/tests/suite/text/font.typ`, `lang.typ`, `lorem.typ`, and
  `smartquote.typ`, unless a specific retained label feature is added first.

## Emoji Cases

Emoji cases should set `requires_system_emoji = true`. On macOS the generator
copies `/System/Library/Fonts/Apple Color Emoji.ttc` into the temporary parity
font directory. If the font is unavailable, the test skips only those cases and
prints the reason.
